source_authority.description: A retained CCEL ThML/XML collection consisting of one catalogue XML file and forty-five component XML files.

evidence: The catalogue describes Calvin's Commentaries as complete.
Its component links enumerate calcom01.xml through calcom45.xml.
The retained catalogue states firstPublished=1578, pubHistory=1847 (Calvin Society), and a Baker, 1996 print source.
The retained catalogue states DC.Rights=Public Domain and DC.Language=eng.

component_scope: calcom31-calcom33: Harmony of Matthew, Mark, and Luke
evidence: Each retained component parses as ThML and carries DC metadata.
The component title pages and metadata carry translator credits by component; they do not support one collection-wide translator field.
calcom01.xml states that the text was translated from the original Latin and compared with the French edition by Rev. John King.
All retained components state DC.Rights=Public Domain and DC.Language=eng.

edition_and_witness_evidence.claim: The collection catalogue identifies a 1578 first publication, 1847 Calvin Society publication history, and Baker Book House, 1996 as the print source.

The first retained component identifies Commentary on Genesis - Volume 1, Rev. John King as translator, and a Baker Book House, 1996 print source; its title page says translated from the original Latin and compared with the French edition.

edition_and_witness_evidence.locator: SourceType, Encoding, CompressType, BlockType, About, SwordVersionDate, Version
edition_and_witness_evidence.claim: The SWORD package is a CrossWire OSIS zCom comparison witness, version 1.1 dated 2022-08-01, converted by Luke Plant from CCEL, with Feature=NoParagraphs.

acquisition_evidence.claim: The retained CCEL acquisition manifest records the catalogue and forty-five component downloads, their byte sizes and hashes, and source-reported Public Domain statements.
The retained XML identifies the CCEL collection source and links the component records.

acquisition_evidence.locator: zip member set and SHA-256 recorded in the ticket manifest
acquisition_evidence.claim: The SWORD archive is retained as a separately hashed comparison witness, not as the reconstruction source.

known_conflicts_and_limits.claim: The existing work config says original_publication_year=1551, while the retained CCEL catalogue says firstPublished=1578.
The SWORD About list omits Acts even though the retained CCEL cohort includes calcom36.xml and calcom37.xml for Acts.
Feature=NoParagraphs marks a known structural loss in the SWORD projection; it is not used as the source-bound TEI authority.
Translator metadata varies by component and includes source spelling variants; this candidate preserves the source facts without collapsing them to one translator.
Public Domain is a source-reported statement retained as evidence; it is not an independent rights clearance or publication authorization.

generated_data_boundary.reason: Existing generated projections are comparison or lineage inputs only and are not source authority for this reconstruction.
